spec: §4.5: "qinplace ... g∘ginv = ginv∘g = id"; §15 C: "T3 over full D ... qinplace pairs"
derivation: inc2(x)=x+1 mod 4, dec2(x)=x-1 mod 4; at B=10 both finish their 3 rows. Expansion computes g(3)=0, exchanges it into x, then dec2(0)=3 clears the saved value. All four values of the two-bit encoding are covered.
